spec_5_3_check.use_client_and_named_export: apps/www-reading-advantage/src/components/marketing/tutor-commission-calculator.tsx starts with "use client" and exports TutorCommissionCalculator with the copy prop of spec 5.3.
spec_5_3_check.arithmetic_source: Every figure comes from @/lib/tutor-commission: calculateNetwork, explainVariant, resizeLegs, commissionRate, NETWORK_PRESETS, and CLASS_PRICE_DEFAULT. The component holds no commission arithmetic.
spec_5_3_check.layout: SectionHeader with eyebrow, heading, and description; the preset row; a 12-column grid at lg with seven columns of input cards and graph and five columns of results; the preset setup under the buttons; the payout graph and the rate curve; the result panel; the explain line; the notes; the disclaimer last.
spec_5_3_check.net_is_the_hero: The result card labels the hero with copy.results.net and shows the net amount. The row list ends at withholding tax, so copy.results.net appears once.
spec_5_3_check.d5_price_reset: applyPreset sets the price from NETWORK_PRESETS, which is 3,000 baht.
spec_5_3_check.d6_first_paint: The default state is price 3,000, 0 own students, and 0 legs. The card shows the explain.zero line and 0 figures.
spec_5_3_check.d7_clear_on_edit: Every input handler sets presetIndex to null, which hides the setup and result text and unpresses the presets. The figures stay.
spec_5_3_check.d9_graph: One row per leg plus the tutor row. Each row has a label, a bar, and the money figures. The bar width is a run-time value in the --bar-width CSS custom property, and one @utility bar-width rule in globals.css reads it. The tutor row shows the pre-tax payout, so the rows add up to the gross.
spec_5_3_check.d11_rate_curve: The SVG is aria-hidden with no alt text. The x axis runs 0 to 500,000 baht and a circle marks the current network volume.
spec_5_3_check.inputs: Every input has a label element with htmlFor, type="number", and min={0}. A new leg starts at 3 students through resizeLegs and LEG_STUDENTS_DEFAULT.
spec_5_3_check.design_rules: Theme colors only (site neutrals and declared emerald shades), no arbitrary Tailwind value, no inline style except --bar-width, min-h-11 on the buttons and leg controls, and wrapping layouts at 390 px.
